why: The floor under design-system/figma/node-types.json's recorded node count. It may rise as `npm run audit:figma-registry` records more mappings, and never falls except by a hand edit that explains the deletion. Re-measure and raise it with `npm run check:figma-node-types -- --update`. Lowered from 85 to 68: Card, Divider, Collapse, Jumbotron, List group, Media object, Scrollspy, Nav pills and Navbar were retired out of Storybook and their 17 node mappings deleted. Lowered from 75 to 72: Dropdown was retired for DropdownMenu, which has no Figma mapping of its own yet, taking its 3 node mappings (button, set, set-list menu) with it. Lowered from 72 to 71: Rating's "with text" mapping (13536:195) was removed because the Rating page has no modern replacement for it, and 34 stale recordings no longer mapped were pruned as the registry moved to current components. Lowered from 71 to 70 (#1629): NavTabs became Tabs on Base UI, repointing from three stale node ids (20095:11829 Nav Tabs, 20095:11987 _Tab Item, 20095:12017 _Tab Dropdown) onto the two Tabs.mdx already cited (69:16779 Nav Tabs, 4209:20411 _Tab Item, both COMPONENT_SET) — a net loss of one, since _Tab Dropdown had no replacement once NavTabs.Dropdown was dropped. Lowered from 70 to 69: the Specs Top Bar (111:227859) left with its mapping when the Sidebar refresh removed the top bar from the frame and its Specs section was deleted. Lowered from 69 to 64 (#2013): 28 current Core sets were recorded and 33 rows for legacy, Archive, page and missing ids left with their mappings; nine components with no Core node now carry status missing with no id. Lowered from 69 to 68: Footer was deleted from code (no such component in the benchmark system), and its mapping to 20978:1305 left with it. Lowered from 68 to 67: AiLabel was deleted (unused; the AI UI section replaced it), and its mapping to 20094:1214 left with it.
